title: Burkina Faso producer (farm-gate) prices
description: Annual producer prices for Burkina Faso from FAOSTAT PP (national official series, flag A), converted LCU/tonne to LCU/kg. Revenue side of the economic screen; farm-gate, so no trader margin (unlike the Ghana SRID wholesale proxy).
not_covered: cotton (seed cotton price is announced per season by AICB/SOFITEX; not in FAOSTAT PP 2021-2024)

provenance.publication: FAOSTAT (2025) Producer Prices (PP), Producer Price (LCU/tonne), annual value, bulk Prices_E_Africa.csv dated 2025-12-23
